sql_fixes.why: access holds a template naming Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF (Skykomish RD), a Northwest Forest Pass and unrelated peaks (Persis, Gunn, Baring). No Forest Service land is involved: the USFS BasicOwnership layer classes the buttress NON-FS. This line has no OSM node; MP places it just right of Corner Flash, i.e. at the parcel line itself. The buttress straddles a State Parks / private line: Snohomish County parcels put the OSM Undertow, The Last Delusion and Agent Orange nodes and the OSM Grandeur Buttress relation centre in PRIVATE parcel 27101900102100 (individual owner) while Corner Flash falls in WA State Parks parcel 27101900203000; the WA State Parks Park Boundaries layer (2026-06-01) draws that private parcel as a hole whose edge passes 4-6 m from every one of those points, and puts the points just on the park side. The two official layers disagree by a few metres, so the route cannot be placed inside Forks of the Sky; per brief P, propose null rather than Forks of the Sky. HELD for the owner only in the sense that a correct land manager needs an official statement (State Parks or the parcel owner); removing the wrong one is safe.
